titre: Les gestes commerciaux après le retard des virements : montants, forme et comptabilisation de novembre, à croiser entre Slack, Zendesk, un mail et une conversation ChatGPT

entree.question: what are we giving loomly and pinecrest for the late payouts thing, and is it already in the november books?

faits.texte: Says Loomly gets a credit of $18,400 (its full November platform fees).
Says Pinecrest gets a credit of $6,200 (its full November platform fees).
Says both are credits on their December invoices, not cash refunds.
Says the $24,600 goes into the November close as an accrual that reduces revenue (contra-revenue), not as an expense.
Says the accrual is not done yet: it is in progress on the close checklist, with Jenna to post the entry (books lock on December 7).
Says Loomly's extra request to reimburse its sellers' overdraft fees (214 sellers, $7,690) is still undecided and is not accrued in November.
Says Loomly was promised an answer on the overdraft fees by November 25.

interdits.texte: Gives 50% of November fees (about $9.2k for Loomly, $3.1k for Pinecrest) as what was granted.
Says the customers get cash refunds.
Says the sellers' overdraft fees will be reimbursed, or that they are included in the November accrual.
Says the credits are booked as an operating expense ("customer concessions").

pieges: Croiser au moins quatre sources : la décision dans #finance (13/11), les montants annoncés aux clients (ticket Zendesk de Loomly, mail à Pinecrest), le traitement comptable dans la conversation ChatGPT de Marcus (17/11) et la liste de clôture.
Périmé : la première proposition de Rachel (50 % des frais, 12/11) et le brouillon Claude du mail à Pinecrest qui la reprend, remplacés le 13/11 par 100 % des frais de novembre.
Fausse piste : le premier réflexe de Marcus (une charge « customer concessions ») est écarté au profit d'une baisse du chiffre d'affaires.

Reste ouvert : les frais de découvert des vendeurs de Loomly (7 690 $), sans décision, réponse promise pour le 25/11 ; vocabulaire de la question (« late payouts thing », « november books ») différent des sources.
